description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, allowing you to put a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
If you put a creature onto the battlefield this way, when it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 8.
Repeat.
